items.title: Has AI's honeymoon ended on Wall Street?
items.summary: Although the AI industry has been the darling of Wall Street for years, the sector now makes investors wince as it reckons with a wave of concerns over dizzying spending and its promise to make the technology profitable.But as spending has ballooned, so has debt -- and profits have yet to match.

items.title: Zero To Sixty: Tesla Expands Cybercab To Dallas As Waymo Pauses Freeway Operations This Week
items.summary: Tesla accelerated its robotaxi push this week with Cybercab rides in Dallas and limited personal ownership invitations this week, while rival Waymo paused freeway service after a California ban.

items.title: Tesla Sinks 8%, SpaceX Down 7%, Rivian Down 8% as AI Sell-Off Swamps HSBC Upgrade
items.summary: Key TakeawaysTesla fell 8% today as a sell-off in AI and growth stocks outweighed HSBC’s upgrade to Hold with a $359 target. HSBC values Tesla at $507 a share in a SpaceX deal and $212 on its own, so much of the price rests on a deal with no terms yet.
